payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed descriptions of the interfaces currently implemented for Macaw, including their functionalities and supported modalities.

claims.text: Macaw currently supports a command line interface, a Telegram bot, and can be accessed via mobile, desktop, and web apps.
The Telegram interface allows multi-modal interactions such as text, speech, image, and click.
Macaw's design allows for easy configuration of different user interfaces and supports speech recognition through online APIs.
